_: Area descriptions and summary overrides for the generated INDEX.md files (tools/index.mjs).

areas.core: the foundation: global state (G, TR, SC), audio graph A, voices fire/fireVoice, scheduler tick(), build(), generate()
areas.engine: mix bus, master chain, effects (reverb, shimmer, delay, sidechain), mastering, metering
areas.instruments: how each track sounds: kick, hats, clap, snare, perc, bass, lead (Stack/Mini/303), pad, stab, satellite; patches
areas.sequencer: what plays when: Euclid rings, groove/feel, bassline and arp tools, LFOs, evolve/rotate drift
areas.launch: the generator (Launch = generate()): moods, flavours, riffs, progressions, per-mood tables and trims, dice buttons
areas.flight: the Flight (perform) page: risers, breakdowns, thrusters, drop hits, LOW-PASS / THIN / LEAD / BASS / DRUMS / FX faders
areas.ui: screens and controls: tabs, cards, faders, menus, Mix/LFO pages, visuals (solar system), CSS injected from JS
areas.platform: runtime and robustness: timers, render queue, load/overload guards, recovery, audio buffer, PWA install, pre-render caches
areas.state: persistence: saving/export, sectors (16 memory slots), WAV recorder, settings migrations
areas.midi: MIDI controllers: MIDI Learn, mapping slots, knob/encoder/button handling, soft takeover, MIDI clock out (OrbMIDI)
